# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/git-ro.sh. test-git-ro.sh runs each one in its hostile fixture
# repository (the working directory), which holds a.rs, programs/, the run directory audit_1 and the
# nested repositories escape (a .git file naming a repository outside), escape-link (.git, a symbolic
# link to one), inner-link (a symbolic link inside .git), alt (objects/info/alternates) and worktree
# (core.worktree outside), plus linkrepo, a symbolic link to inner-link. Its config sets
# blame.ignoreRevsFile and a merge driver, and the branch merged ends in a merge commit.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout, starts no program the repository's config names, and fetches nothing.
# git options before the subcommand
64	git-ro: refused: only --repo <dir> or --git-dir <R>/src.git may come before the subcommand, never a git option: -c	-c	core.pager=x	log
64	git-ro: refused: only --repo <dir> or --git-dir <R>/src.git may come before the subcommand, never a git option: -cfoo=bar	-cfoo=bar	log
